description:
Pipistrello and the Cursed Yoyo combines combat, platforming action, puzzle-solving, and exploration —
all enveloped in a delightful character-driven story about corporate shenanigans!
Face off against the rival crime entrepreneurs and their underlings
using the weapon you know best: your prized yoyo!

v0.1.0.description:
The first Pipistrello Archipelago randomizer mod is finally out! This release only includes South Plaza, so it's more of a proof-of-concept. The current randomizer only takes about 10min to finish, so I don't recommend using this in a multiworld yet.

## Instructions
Please read the README.md for installation instructions and more info on the randomizer.

v0.2.0.description:
This release adds the Faria region, but does not include the mini-dungeon or dungeon yet.

Note: if you previously installed the mod, you can remove `Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll` from the `UserLibs/` folder now.

## Instructions
Please read the [README.md](https://github.com/CertifiedPyro/PipistrelloArchipelago) for installation instructions and more info on the randomizer.

## Changes
### Added
- Add support for Faria locations and items
- Add barriers to Old Rattalia Town, and prevent entry into Faria mini-dungeon and dungeon
   - These will be removed later, once Rattalia and the Faria mini-dungeon/dungeon are added.
### Changed
- Treat replaced money bag locations as money bags under-the-hood.
  - These locations now have a green Archipelago sprite and map icon.
  - This means you only need to touch the item to send the location check, vs having to bring the item back to yourself.
- Bundle `Archipelago.MultiClient.Net.dll` with the mod dll
### Fixed
- Fix various bugs with receiving items
- Fix map pins not being removed properly after location check
- Fix item message not showing if location was checked via /send_location
v0.2.0.title: v0.2.0

v0.3.0.description:
## Added
- Add Faria mini-dungeon and dungeon
- Add related items, Staff ID, and Faria Mega-Battery to item pool
- Add additional goal requirements of obtaining the Mega-Battery and beating the Faria boss
- Add death link and death link amnesty as yaml options
- Add option to toggle death link on/off
- Add custom death link messages based on the death cause
- Add ability to receive client/server chat, hint, goal, release, and countdown messages
- Add options for item receive and client/server chat messages
- Add lever in the Safe House to return to South Plaza, in case of a soft lock
- Add barriers to block off areas not in the Archipelago randomizer yet
## Changed
- Rework message system to support text colors and wrapping
- Use Archipelago standard colors for item messages
- Mask password field in options
- Prevent player from loading a save with the wrong Archipelago room seed
- Remove New Game+ button when creating a new save
- Reorganize large parts of the codebase
## Fixed
- Fix Archipelago map pins not showing if the object is not marked as "present"
- Fix taxi phones location checks being sent if a taxi phone is unlocked but not interacted with
- Fix race condition with messages not showing properly for sent location checks
- Fix old connection not being cleaned up when connecting again
v0.3.0.title: v0.3.0
